text_block_list.text:
Hey! Don't you think I look super
grown-up?
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text:
Since we had the day off yesterday, I
was gonna
stay up all night! ♪ But when
I talked to Nature...
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text: She said if I wanna be more mature, I should actually go to bed early!
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text:
I listened to her advice, and now my hair
is as soft
as silk. I feel like I could fly to
the moon! But first,
I'm gonna steal your
heart!
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text:
It looks like Маяно Топ Ган rested
well, both
mentally and physically.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
